justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ErasureMatcher.java`, `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ElementMatchers.java`, and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ErasureMatcherTest.java`. `ErasureMatcher` is a small adapter with one field (`ElementMatcher<? super TypeDescription> matcher`), one constructor, and one delegate call in `doMatch(T target)` to `matcher.matches(target.asErasure())`; it does not depend on many classes. Incoming usage is also limited: the only production reference found is `ElementMatchers.erasure(...)` creating a new `ErasureMatcher`, with the rest of the references in the test class. This is low fan-in/low fan-out, not a dependency hub.
